description: Save what the user tells you about themselves to their Fundz account, so they never have to open Fundz to finish setup: their own name, their job title, company name, website, phone, booking link, a one or two sentence description of what the company does, their role, and the job titles of the people they sell to. Use it during "Set up Fundz" whenever check_outreach_setup shows something MISSING, and any time the user says things like "my title is", "my booking link is", "we sell to CFOs". Ask in plain words, one question at a time, and save each answer as you get it. Only the fields you pass are changed; an empty field never erases what is on file. role can be set only when the account has no role yet, and must be one of the slugs check_outreach_setup lists. target_titles are ADDED to the titles on file. Industries, locations and company sizes are not saved here: use update_targeting_preferences for those. Read the result back to the user in one or two lines, including anything refused.

booking_link.description: Link where a prospect books a meeting, e.g. a Calendly link

description.description: One or two sentences on what the company does and for whom, in the user's own words

name.description: The user's own first and last name, as it should appear under their emails

phone.description: Phone number for the email signature (optional)

role.description: Role slug from the list check_outreach_setup returns (only when no role is set yet)

target_titles.description: Job titles of the people the user sells to or places, e.g. ["CFO", "VP Finance"]. Added to the titles on file (10 per call).

title.description: The user's own job title, e.g. "Managing Partner"

website.description: The company website or domain, e.g. "acme.com"

title: Save sender profile
